invariants.rationale: The method clamps the 'pixels' value and sets scrolling, which would not behave correctly with NaN input.
A scroll position as positive or negative infinity is not meaningful; the method clamps scroll position.
Covers all cases except NaN, which is a reasonable invariant for scroll values.
Since only 'pixels' is known and unconstrained, almost any non-tautological invariant would be speculative.
